purpose: Independent diagnostics of convention conflicts; these sources do not supply imported answer authority. All ready keys require saved Math Academy evidence.

references.title: OpenStax Calculus Volume 1, Theorem 4.5
references.supports: The standard derivative MVT chooses c strictly between the endpoints. MA explicitly states closed-segment membership instead; the discrepancy is recorded as a convention/content ambiguity.

references.title: MIT 18.06, Definition of Row Echelon Form
references.supports: Ordinary echelon conditions apply to all matrix entries, including zeros below leading entries and strict rightward leading-entry positions. MA instead applies the test only to the coefficient block of the augmented matrix.
